# CLI — Command-line client

- Owner: `ticonnect-cli`
- Stage: 2
- Layer: `clients`
- Component graph: [generated/components/cli.md](generated/components/cli.md)

## Purpose

Own command parsing, daemon IPC client, settings client, output formats, and debugging commands.

## Boundary

Client process. Talks to daemon over D-Bus and settings directly. No storage or network access.

- None
